test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain sum of money lent out at simple interest amounts ₹13,000 in 3 years and ₹15,000 in 5 years. Find the rate per cent per annum.
solution:
**Given:-**

Amount(A) = 13000

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula used:-**

Amount = Principle + Simple Interest 

Simple Interest = {Principal(P) × Time(T) × Rate(R)}/100

**Calculation:-**

According to the question,

⇒ P + (P × 3 × r)/100 = 13000 ... .........(i)

⇒ P + (P × 5 × r)/100 = 15000.................(ii) 

S.I. for two years = 15000 – 13000= ₹ 2000

 ⇒ (P × 2 × r )/100 = 2000

∴ Pr/100 = 1000...................(iii)

∴ From equation (i)

⇒ P + 1000 × 3 = 13000

⇒ P = 13000 – 3000 = ₹ 10000

From equation (iii)

⇒ (10000 × r )/100 = 1000

⇒ r = 100/10 = 10 %

 

**∴ The required answer is 10%.**
